answer: Agents escrow bonded stake and commit to an epoch-scoped polynomial. RLN proofs let them send messages within a rate limit without revealing identity; duplicate use of a nullifier exposes distinct Shamir shares, whose interpolation recovers the private rate-limit key and proves abuse, triggering immediate collateral slashing. A sonnet may describe the rule, but the island of permitted messages is enforced cryptographically, with jade-marked epochs preventing cross-epoch replay.
